% ADDED figure (2026-11-23): the four polarization directions of a photon along z, and which terms of the polarization sum survive; generated by qft-C/tools/l22/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\tikzset{
  fline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.56 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5.5pt, width=4.5pt]}}}},
  sline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, dash pattern=on 3.5pt off 2.2pt},
  blob/.style={draw, line width=0.8pt, fill=figB!12},
}
\tikzset{
  pline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, decorate, decoration={snake, amplitude=1.6pt, segment length=5.2pt}},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small, >=Stealth]
  % axes
  \draw[gray, ->] (0,0)--(3.6,0) node[right, font=\scriptsize] {$z$};
  \draw[gray, ->] (0,0)--(0,2.0) node[above, font=\scriptsize] {$x$};
  \draw[gray, ->] (0,0)--(-1.15,-0.95) node[below left=-2pt, font=\scriptsize] {$y$};
  % momentum
  \draw[fdmom, line width=1.1pt] (0,-0.28)--(3.0,-0.28); \node[figO, below] at (1.7,-0.3) {$k^\mu = (\kappa, 0, 0, \kappa)$};
  % transverse (physical)
  \draw[->, figB, line width=1.3pt] (0,0)--(0,1.45); \node[figB, right] at (0.05,1.3) {$\epsilon_1 = (0,1,0,0)$};
  \draw[->, figB, line width=1.3pt] (0,0)--(-0.82,-0.68); \node[figB, left] at (-0.85,-0.45) {$\epsilon_2 = (0,0,1,0)$};
  % longitudinal
  \draw[->, figR, line width=1.3pt, densely dashed] (0,0.0)--(1.5,0.0); \node[figR, above] at (1.55,0.02) {longitudinal $(0,0,0,1)$};
  % timelike, drawn apart
  \draw[gray, ->] (5.0,-0.6)--(5.0,1.6) node[above, font=\scriptsize] {$t$};
  \draw[->, figR, line width=1.3pt, densely dashed] (5.0,-0.3)--(5.0,1.05); \node[figR, right] at (5.05,0.4) {timelike $(1,0,0,0)$};
  \node[figB, font=\footnotesize] at (-0.6,2.55) {physical: transverse};
  \node[figR, font=\footnotesize] at (4.6,2.55) {unphysical};
  % the sum
  \node[anchor=west, font=\footnotesize, align=left] at (-2.6,-2.25) {$-g_{\mu\nu}\,\mathcal M^\mu\mathcal M^{\nu*} \;=\; \underbrace{\textcolor{figB}{|\mathcal M^1|^2 + |\mathcal M^2|^2}}_{\text{physical sum}} \;+\; \underbrace{\textcolor{figR}{|\mathcal M^3|^2 - |\mathcal M^0|^2}}_{=\,0\ \text{by}\ k_\mu\mathcal M^\mu \,=\, \kappa(\mathcal M^0 - \mathcal M^3) \,=\, 0}$};
\end{tikzpicture}
